parameters.name: CateId
parameters.description:
The category ID. You can obtain the ID by using one of the following methods:
- Log on to the [ApsaraVideo VOD console](https://vod.console.aliyun.com) and choose **Configuration Management** > **Media Management** > **Categories** to view the category ID.
- Obtain the category ID from the value of the CateId response parameter when you call the [AddCategory](~~56401~~) operation to create a category.
- Call the [GetCategories](~~56406~~) operation to query the category ID, which is the value of the CateId response parameter.

parameters.name: CoverURL
parameters.description: The thumbnail URL of the audio or video file.

parameters.name: Description
parameters.description:
The description of the audio or video file.

- The description can be up to 1024 bytes in length.
- The value is encoded in UTF-8.

parameters.name: ReferenceId
parameters.description: The custom ID. Only lowercase letters, uppercase letters, digits, hyphens, and underscores are supported. The value must be 6 to 64 characters in length and is unique at the user level.

parameters.name: Tags
parameters.description:
The tags.

- Each tag can be up to 32 bytes in length. A maximum of 16 tags can be specified.
- Separate multiple tags with commas (,).
- The value is encoded in UTF-8.

parameters.name: Title
parameters.description:
The title of the audio or video file.

- The title can be up to 128 bytes in length.
- The value is encoded in UTF-8.

parameters.name: UserData
parameters.description: The custom settings. The value is a JSON string that supports settings such as message callbacks and upload acceleration. For more information, see [UserData](~~86952~~).

parameters.name: VideoId
parameters.description:
The audio or video ID. You can obtain the ID by using one of the following methods:
- For videos uploaded through the console, log on to the [ApsaraVideo VOD console](https://vod.console.aliyun.com) and choose **Media Files** > **Audio/Video** to view the audio or video ID.
- Obtain the video ID from the value of the VideoId response parameter when you call the [CreateUploadVideo](~~55407~~) operation to obtain the upload URL and credential.
- After the video is uploaded, call the [SearchMedia](~~86044~~) operation to query the audio or video ID, which is the value of the VideoId response parameter.
